stories.summary: Create a test project in one transaction with the authenticated author recorded as owner_id and as the only owner member; the projects list links to the create form and the project page exposes the owner's 'Add member' and 'Settings' entry points

Owner-only member management through the shared member-management owner check: add a known skill-builders user by email, remove a member who then loses project access, and refuse unknown emails, duplicate members, non-owner changes and removal of the owner
Members and the owner open the project's run-start page while signed-in non-members and removed members are refused with 403 before any project or run data is returned

Project settings show the owner the integration management controls while a non-owner member is read-only and refused changes and a non-member is refused the page, all through the shared owner check using the integration-management message
